# Hackettstown Junk Removal
Same-day junk removal based at 49 Asbury Road, Hackettstown, NJ 07840.
Phone: (862) 244-3630
Serves every municipality in Warren, Morris, and Sussex counties, New Jersey.
Pricing: by truck volume, single items from about $75, full truck often $500+.
Does not haul hazardous waste.
Primary site: https://hackettstownjunkremoval.com
